name: drop_key_val
parent: Handle < NodeRef < marker :: Dying , K , V , NodeType > , marker :: KV >
documentation:
Drops the key and value that the KV handle refers to.
 # Safety
 The node that the handle refers to must not yet have been deallocated.
rules: For safety, the node that the handle refers to must not yet have been deallocated when `drop_key_val` is called.
